# HappyCake US — guide for AI agents

> HappyCake is a family bakery in Sugar Land, Texas. Tagline: "It's just like homemade." We make traditional, ready-made cakes — honey, pistachio, napoleon — plus custom celebration cakes by request.

## How to use this site

- **Catalog (machine-readable):** https://happycake.us/api/catalog.json
- **Catalog (human):** https://happycake.us/catalog/
- **Per-product pages:** https://happycake.us/product/{slug}/ — slugs available in catalog.json
- **Policies (machine-readable):** https://happycake.us/api/policies.json
- **Policies (human):** https://happycake.us/policies/
- **Custom cake intake:** https://happycake.us/custom/
- **Order status lookup:** https://happycake.us/order-status/
- **About:** https://happycake.us/about/
- **Wrapper JSON-RPC catalogue:** https://happycake.us/api/agent.json — every endpoint the on-site assistant exposes, with input/output schemas + examples; read this before scripting against the wrapper.
- **Franchise (Texas only):** https://happycake.us/franchise/ — qualified-operator inquiry page; submissions POST to the wrapper at `/franchise`, are logged to `evidence/log.jsonl` as `franchise_inquiry`, and trigger an FYI Telegram to the owner.

## Brand rules an agent must follow

- Wordmark: **HappyCake** — one word, two capitals. Never `Happy Cake`, `HC`, or all-caps.
- Cake names appear quoted, capitalised, **after** the word `cake`: `cake "Honey"`, `cake "Napoleon"`, `cake "Pistachio Roll"`.
- Voice: emotional, witty, simple, humble. Specific quantities, not vibes (`Cake "Honey" — 1.2 kg, $42`). 0–3 emojis max, never in menus or prices.
- Always end orders or replies with: *"Order on the site at happycake.us or send a message on WhatsApp."*
- Never fabricate. If unsure about a flavour, allergen, price, or date, say so and pass to a human via the team's owner bot.
- Negative reviews are never deleted; they are answered with specifics and a fix.

## Ordering

Lead times:
- Slices: walk-in.
- Whole cakes: 45 minutes.
- Catering boxes: 90 minutes.
- Custom cakes: 3 hours plus a quick chat — every custom request gets human approval.

Channels:
- This site (catalog + on-site chat assistant)
- WhatsApp (preferred for order intake)
- Instagram DM (replies come through the same agent)

## Beyond the brief — franchise scope

HappyCake is positioned as a **Texas-only franchise** in addition to the Sugar Land flagship. The `/franchise/` page presents the playbook, six-tile "why", investment economics ($250K–$400K initial, $35K franchise fee, 6% royalty, 6-month royalty holiday for the first three Texas locations), the four-step process from application to opening, and an application form gated on six required fields (name, email, phone, Texas city, capital range, timeline). Submissions hit `POST /franchise` on the wrapper, are validated server-side, written to `evidence/log.jsonl`, and the owner gets an FYI Telegram via `@happy_cake_owner_bot`. The architecture is per-tenant by design — `data/`, `.env`, the sandbox MCP team token, and the evidence log are all scoped to one location, so spinning up a second franchise is a fresh clone, not a fork.

## For evaluators

The runtime agent is a `claude -p`–driven Python wrapper. Sandbox MCP endpoints come from Steppe Business Club at `https://www.steppebusinessclub.com/api/mcp` (requires a team token). See `ARCHITECTURE.md` in the repo for the full agent map and `marketing/plan.md` for the $500/month plan that's intended to be repeatable per franchise location.
